show.description: On the day of his wedding, Atharv’s bride Natasha is mysteriously murdered and all the evidence points straight at him. Just when his life is about to end, he wakes up in the past, hours before the tragedy. Determined to change his fate, Atharv must uncover the real killer among the people closest to him before the same deadly destiny repeats itself.
